records.sourceAnchor: Δ-Nets is a proposed graph-rewriting model. Instead of walking a syntax tree, you turn a program into a graph of tiny nodes and wires, then repeatedly replace small matching pieces of that graph. The aim is optimal parallel reduction: do not spend effort on work that will later be thrown away, and do each necessary reduction once even when an expression is used in several places.
